name: Thunder Rend
description: Rend a narrow line through the guard with a bolt of hard thunder qi at close range.

name: Downburst
description: Drop a violent column of air from above the user that flattens everything beneath it.

name: Squall Seal
description: Close a ring of squall about the foe to shut his qi flow while the ring holds.

name: Quenching Rain
description: Pour a quenching rain over allies to wash fever and poison and scorch-taint from their bodies.

name: Sheer Tempest
description: Draw a sheer wall of tempest across the field and push it forward to scour all before it.

name: Storm Bulwark
description: Raise a rotating bulwark of storm over the user and allies that breaks a heavy assault.

name: Lightning Net
description: Cast a net of lightning over the opponents that jolts and holds all who touch its strands.

name: Voltaic Surge
description: Surge forward as a streak of charge and strike the target at the end of the run.

name: Thunderhead Crash
description: Collapse a mountain of cloud onto the target in one crash that flattens the ground round him.

name: Cyclone Jaws
description: Open a cyclone with a wide mouth that drags foes in and grinds them through its spin.

name: Skyfall Bolt
description: Call one bolt out of the highest cloud that strikes through all guards and defences alike.

name: Ruinous Squall
description: The school's closing move that unleashes the whole storm in one squall with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Annihilating Tempest
description: Raise a storm to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier and let it fall across a whole field of battle.

name: Sky Rend
description: Tear a thin high seam in the air with a bolt that comes down on the target.

name: Charge Veil
description: Hang a crackling veil of charge before the body that shocks anything that touches it.

name: Spark Net
description: Throw a close net of sparks that jolts the foe's muscles and clings to his limbs.

name: Calming Drizzle
description: Let a fine warm drizzle fall over wounded allies that closes cuts and soothes shaken nerves.

name: Rending Cloudburst
description: Burst the held cloud overhead in a torrent that tears at all caught beneath it.

name: Splitting Peal
description: Break a peal of thunder against the target's guard in one strike that bursts it from within.

name: Weathercloak
description: Wear a cloak of moving weather that shields the body and carries it between blows.

name: Thunder Surge
description: Pour a surge of thunder along the ground in waves that shake the footing of all in range.

name: Zenith Bolt
description: Call a single bolt from straight overhead that passes through armour and ward to strike the chosen body.

name: Supercell Step
description: Flash across the field inside a rotating storm cell and strike from within its turning mass.

name: Maelstrom Crush
description: Wind a maelstrom of rain and thunder down on the field to crush all it catches into the ground.

name: Rending Verdict
description: The school's closing move that tears one great bolt through the sky and the foe with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Sky Annihilation
description: Open the sky over a wide land and let its whole weight of thunder fall to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Storm Apocalypse
description: Bring a storm of ruinous scale down on the ground that crushes and breaks all its tier can reach.
